 PRE BOOKING FORM 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 DEFINITIONS 
 Booking Payment means the booking payment of the Unit(s) as specified in the Booking Form . 
 General Terms and Conditions means these General Terms and Conditions appended to the Booking Form, which forms an integral part thereto. 
 Inventory means [●] units in the Project booked by the Interested Purchaser as specified in Annexure A. For the avoidance of doubt the Inventory shall be available to the Interested Purchaser after the Vesting Period as per terms and conditions specified herein. 
 Vesting Period means the period of [●] months commencing from [●] to [●] , subject to Clause s 5.1 and 5 .2 below , after which the Interested Purchaser shall enter into an agreement to sell Units as per the se General T erms and Conditions . For the avoidance of doubt, during the Vesting Period the Interested Purchaser can assign/sell its vested right in the Unit s to the third party. 
 Premium means , where a Unit is assigned/sold to a third party and the Sale Price (defined below) is higher than the Purchase Price, the difference between the two. 
 Project means ________________ [ details of project ] ____________________________. 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Interested Purchaser to purchase the Units ( ex clusive of tax), as identified in the Booking Form . 
 Sale Price means the price at which the Interested Purchaser assigns/sells a Unit(s) to a third - party buyer . 
 Unit means a single [●] in the Project as listed in the Inventory in Annexure A. Collectively referred to as “Units”. 
 SCOPE 
 The Parties are executing this Booking Form whereby the Developer grants to the Interested Purchaser the right of first purchase against the Units in the Inventory, subject to the payment of Booking Payment. 
 RIGHT TO FIRST PURCHASE AND OPTIONS FOR INTERESTED PURCHASER 
 The Developer has granted to the Interested Purchaser the right of first purchase with respect to the Units in the Inventory against the payment of a total Rs. [●] ( “ Total Booking Payment ” ) and the Developer acknowledges the receipt of the Total Booking Payment via pay order /cheque No. [●] dated [●] a copy of which is attached in Annexure B. 
 The Parties agree that upon expiry of the Vesting Period, the Developer shall offer, to the Interested Purchaser, to sell, transfer and convey the Unit (s) (along with all rights, title and interests attached thereto), and upon payment of the Purchase Price as per the payment plan specified in Annexure C , the Developer shall do all such acts, deeds and things ancillary thereto, including inter alia executing the agreement(s) to sell and issuing allotment letter(s), in favour of the Interested Purchaser or any third party nominated by the Int e r e sted Purchaser, as and when notified by the Inte r ested Purchaser. 
 As security for grant of the right to first purchase to the Interested Purchaser, the Developer shall deposit all sale/purchase documentation of the Unit (s) and issue the open file (s) of the Unit (s) , along with all ancillary documents with respect to the sale, transfer and conveyance, of the Unit (s) ( “ Transfer Instrument ” ), and deposit the Transfer Instrument with the Interested Purchaser at the time of execution of this Booking Form . 
 In the event the Interested Purchaser assign s its right to first purchase in the Unit(s) to any third part ( ies ) during or after the Vesting Period , the terms and conditions with respect to the such sale/assignment, including inter alia pricing and payment plan, shall be determined by the Interested Purchaser at its sole discretion and the Developer shall sell, transfer and convey such Unit(s) (along with all rights, title and interests attached thereto), and do all such acts, deeds and things ancillary thereto, including inter alia executing the agreement(s) to sell and issuing allotment letter(s), in favour of the any third party nominated by the Interested Purchaser, as and when notified by the Interested Purchaser . 
 In the event Premium is earned on the assignment/ sale of the vested rights of the Interested Purchaser in the Unit (s) to a third party under Clause REF _Ref104215361 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.4 , the Developer is liable to pay to the Interested Purchaser 100% of the Premium amount without any deductions whatsoever. 
 Upon expiry of the Vesting Period, i n the event that the Interested Purchaser has not exercise d its right to first purchase in any number of Units as per Clause REF _Ref103936305 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.2 above or has not assigned its right to first purchase under Clause 3.4 above , the Developer shall set -off the Down Payment of the remaining/unsold Units (“ Remaining Down Payment ”) as full and final sale consideration against the sale , transfer and conv e y ance of the remaining/unsold Units identif ied by the Interested Purchaser at the time of expiry of the Vesting Period (“ Set - o ff Units ”) , and do all such acts, deeds and things ancillary thereto, including inter alia executing the agreement(s) to sell and issuing allotment letter(s), in favour of the Interested Purchaser. Provided that the cumulative Purchase Price of the S et-off Units shall always be equal to or lower than the Remaining Down Payment. In the event that the cumulative Purchase Price of the S et-off Units is lower than the Remaining Down Payment, the difference between the two (“ Settlement Amount ”) shall be refunded by the Developer to the Interested Purchaser in clear funds without any deductions whatsoever. 
 In the event of sale, transfer and conveyance of the Units as per C lause REF _Ref103936578 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.6 above, the Interested Purchaser shall return to the Developer the Transfer Instruments of all unsold/ remaining Units other than the Set -o ff Units (the “ Remaining Units ”) within [●] days of the sale, transfer and conveyance of Set-off Units , subject to the Developer furnishing a cross-cheque of the Settlement Amount in favour of ‘Zameen Media (Private) Limited’, if any . 
 DEVELOPER’S WARRANTIES 
 The Developer hereby acknowledges represents and warrants that: 
 it has the lawful authority to enter into and execute this Booking Form and the General Terms and Conditions attached thereto through the duly authorized representative first mentioned above. 
 the Developer is the absolute owner of the Units and the Units are and shall remain free and clear from all disputes, claims, liens, mortgages, charges, burdens and/or encumbrances whatsoever . 
 it has not done or caused or suffered to be done any act, deed, matter or thing whereby its right to sell , transfer and convey all its rights, title and interests in the Units free and clear of claims, litigation, revenue demands, liens, mortgages, charges, burdens or encumbrances of any nature to the Interested Purchaser has been or may be impaired or impeached. 
 no additional consent, approval or authorization is required for the Developer to enter into, deliver or perform its obligations under th ese General Terms and Condition. 
 to the best of Developer’s knowledge , it has not received notification of any kind from any governmental agency regarding actual or potential with regards to any of the Unit(s). 
 DEVELOPER OBLIGATIONS 
 The Developer hereby undertakes and warrants that the Developer shall strictly adhere to the construction schedule of the Project as more fully detailed in Annexure E (“ Schedule of Work ”). Any delay in construction by the Developer in terms of the Schedule of Work shall result in an automatic extension of time in the Vesting Period, which shall be at least equal to the time of delay on the part of the Developer. The Developer further undertakes and accepts to provide monthly construction updates to the Interested Purchaser, no later than on the [●] day of each calendar month throughout the Vesting Period in the manner and form provided in Annexure E. 
 The Developer hereby undertakes and warrants that the Developer shall obtain all necessary permissions, approvals and NOCs for the Project from all competent authorities: land, revenue and/or any other department; federal, provincial and/or local governments, or any other department(s) or authority( ies ) concerned, strictly in accordance with the timelines set out in Annexure F (“ Project Approvals ”). Any delay in obtaining necessary approvals/permission by the Developer in terms of the Project Approvals shall result in an automatic extension of time in the Vesting Period, which shall be at least equal to the time of delay on the part of the Developer . 
 The Developer hereby acknowledges and confirms that the Interested Purchaser is relaying on the representations and warranties of the Developer under this Booking Form, as specifically stipulated under Clause s 5 .1 and 5 .2 above for executing this Booking Form. In the event of any breach of warranty or of any obligation under Clauses 5 .1 and 5 .2 above, the Interested Purchaser shall be entitled to terminate this Booking Form and claim the Indemnity Amount (defined below) in the mode and manner stipulated in Clause 1 2 .2 below. 
 AMENDMENT AND TERMINATION 
 All additions, amendments and variations to this Booking Form and/or the General Terms and Conditions shall be binding only if in writing and signed by duly authorized representatives of both Parties, and shall be executed in the form of an addendum, which shall be read as an integral part of this Booking Form . 
 This Booking Form shall only be terminated through mutual consent of both Parties in writing, in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof. For the avoidance of doubt, neither party shall have the right to unilaterally terminate this Booking Form . 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means any event or occurrence beyond the control of the Parties (including but not limited to any injunction/stay order, government notification, spread of infectious disease on Project site) that prevents the Parties from completing or performing its obligations under the se General Terms and Conditions . 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the estimated completion date or completion date, the Developer shall as soon as practicable notify the Interested Purchaser in writing of the event and give the Interested Purchaser a revised estimated completion date or completion date, as and when it can be determined. 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 This Booking Form, the General Terms and Conditions and Annexures attached thereto constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and overrides, supersedes, cancels any other negotiations, commitments, discussions, representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, made by the Parties or their representatives. 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 The Booking Form and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to the Booking Form shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to clause REF _Ref97109984 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 9.2 , the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction. 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Booking From will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940. After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one each to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 NOTICES 
 All notices s hall be delivered via email or written letters. Emails shall be deemed delivered after twenty-four (24) hours of being sent. Written letters shall be deemed to have been delivered after three (3) working days of being posted, provided such letters were sent via a reputable courier company. It is the responsibility of the Parties to promptly update the other Party of any change of address or email address.

 INDEMNITY 
 The Developer shall indemnify the Interested Purchaser against all claims, damages, losses, costs, expenses, encumbrances, charges etc. arising out of any defect in title of the Developer of the Units or possession, or out of any representation, warranty or covenant stated herein not being true, correct or complied with. 
 Without prejudice to the generality of Clause 1 2 .1 above and the rights and remedies available to the Interested Purchaser thereunder, in the event of termination of this Booking Form under Clause 5 .3 or in the event that any litigation or legal proceeding(s) ensues in relation to the Project and/or the Inventory inter alia any injunctive order being granted by a court of competent jurisdiction against the Project and/or the Inventory, the Developer shall indemnify the Interested Purchaser with an amount equal to the Rs. _____________ (Rupees _________million) (the “ Indemnity Amount ”). In the event of exercise of indemnification under this Clause 1 2 .2 and as promise to pay the Indemnity Amount in future by the Developer to the Interested Purchaser, the Developer grants to the Interested Buyer, the unconditional right to encash the post-dated cheques attached in Annexure D the details of which are as follows:

 The Developer further agrees and acknowledges that in the event the banker’s cheques referred to in Clause 1 2 .2 is dishonored or payment is refused by the issuing bank for any reason whatsoever, in addition to any other remedy available to the Interested Purchaser, Interested Purchaser shall have the right to initiate proceedings under the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 and any other applicable laws against the Developer . 
 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
 The Interested Purchaser shall not be liable for any breach of provincial or federal law or non-compliance with any other applicable law for the time being in force by the Developer with regards to the Units, or for any other reason whatsoever, and the Interested Purchaser shall not be liable to pay any penalty that may be imposed in respect thereof or bear any costs in association therewith . 
 WAIVER 
 No right or remedy conferred upon or reserved by the Interested Purchaser under this Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions is intended to be or shall be deemed to be exclusive of any other right or remedy herein or by law or equity provided or permitted, but each such right or remedy shall be cumulative of every other right or remedy. The Interested Purchaser ’s failure or delay in exercising any right, power or privilege under this Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions will not operate as a waiver thereof. 
 SEVERABILITY 
 If any one or more provisions of the Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions and any documents, data, notices or information disclosed or shared by the Party, oral or written, shall be regarded as confidential information by the other Party and take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties, except where such disclosure is required under any law or court order. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Booking Form. 
 GOOD FAITH 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under the Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 The Booking Form and these General Terms and Conditions may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Booking Form . 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
